overview: Graham,NC PD uses Flock Safety technology to capture objective evidence without compromising individual privacy. Graham, NC PD uses retroactive searches to solve crimes after they occur. Additionally, Graham, NC PD utilizes real-time alerting of hotlist vehicles to capture wanted criminals. To ensure proper use and guardrails are in place, they have made the policies and usage statistics below available to the public.
acceptable_use: Data is used for law enforcement purposes only. Data is owned by Graham NC PD and is never sold to 3rd parties.
prohibited_uses: Immigration enforcement, traffic enforcement, harassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), Personal use.
access_policy:
All system access shall be based upon a valid law enforcement purpose, and all officer searches and related system activity shall be retained indefinitely.
Each officer granted access to the system shall complete required training on its proper use and review the agency’s ALPR policy governing authorized access and system usage.
Once access has been granted, officers shall access the system using multi-factor authentication (MFA) to help prevent unauthorized access.
hotlist_policy:
No enforcement action is authorized unless the underlying hotlist trigger has been verified as active by the on-duty supervisor or the officer taking the enforcement action. Verification may be conducted through DCI, NCIC, or by contacting the agency that entered the hotlist record.
All agency hotlist entries shall be completed by the on-duty supervisor to ensure that all applicable requirements and guidelines have been satisfied prior to entry.
